title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Establishment of the International Commercial Court

articles.content_en: Article 1 The Supreme People's Court establishes an International Commercial Court. The International Commercial Court is a permanent adjudication organ of the Supreme People's Court.

Article 4 The judges of the International Commercial Court shall be selected by the Supreme People's Court from among senior judges who have rich experience in adjudication work, are familiar with international treaties, international practices and international trade and investment practice, and are able to proficiently use both Chinese and English as working languages.

Article 5 The International Commercial Court shall, in trying cases, form a collegial panel composed of three or more judges.
The collegial panel shall conduct deliberations in accordance with the principle that the minority is subordinate to the majority. Minority opinions may be recorded in the adjudication document.
Article 6 A preservation ruling made by the International Commercial Court may designate a lower people's court to enforce it.

Article 7 When the International Commercial Court tries a case, the substantive law applicable to the dispute shall be determined in accordance with the provisions of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Application of Laws to Foreign-Related Civil Relations.
Where the parties choose the applicable law in accordance with the provisions of law, the law chosen by the parties shall apply.

Article 9 Where the evidentiary materials submitted by a party to the International Commercial Court are formed outside the territory of the People's Republic of China, they shall be examined in court regardless of whether notarization, authentication or other certification formalities have been completed.
Where the evidentiary materials submitted by a party are in English and the other party agrees, the party may not submit a Chinese translation.

Article 10 The International Commercial Court may use audio-visual transmission technology and other information network methods for the investigation and collection of evidence and for organizing examination of evidence.

Article 11 The Supreme People's Court shall establish an International Commercial Expert Committee and select qualified international commercial mediation institutions and international commercial arbitration institutions, which together with the International Commercial Court shall construct a dispute resolution platform with organic integration of mediation, arbitration and litigation, forming a 'one-stop' international commercial dispute resolution mechanism.
The International Commercial Court shall support parties in resolving international commercial disputes through the dispute resolution platform with organic integration of mediation, arbitration and litigation, and by choosing the means they deem appropriate.

Article 12 Within seven days after accepting a case, the International Commercial Court may, with the consent of the parties, entrust members of the International Commercial Expert Committee or an international commercial mediation institution to conduct mediation.

Article 13 Where, through mediation presided over by a member of the International Commercial Expert Committee or an international commercial mediation institution, the parties reach a mediation agreement, the International Commercial Court may, in accordance with the law, issue a mediation document; if the parties request a judgment, it may issue a judgment based on the contents of the agreement and serve it on the parties.

Article 14 Where the parties by agreement choose an international commercial arbitration institution specified in paragraph 1 of Article 11 of these Provisions for arbitration, they may apply to the International Commercial Court for preservation of evidence, property or conduct before applying for arbitration or after the arbitration proceedings have commenced.
Where a party applies to the International Commercial Court to set aside or enforce an arbitration award made by an international commercial arbitration institution specified in paragraph 1 of Article 11 of these Provisions, the International Commercial Court shall conduct review in accordance with the Civil Procedure Law and other relevant legal provisions.

Article 15 Judgments and rulings made by the International Commercial Court are legally effective judgments and rulings.
A mediation document made by the International Commercial Court, upon being signed and received by both parties, shall have the same legal effect as a judgment.

Article 16 A party may, in accordance with the Civil Procedure Law, apply to the headquarters of the Supreme People's Court for retrial of a judgment, ruling or mediation document made by the International Commercial Court that has become legally effective.
When the headquarters of the Supreme People's Court accepts applications for retrial and retrial cases as specified in the preceding paragraph, it shall form a separate collegial panel.

Article 17 With respect to judgments, rulings and mediation documents made by the International Commercial Court that have become legally effective, the parties may apply to the International Commercial Court for enforcement.

Article 18 The International Commercial Court shall provide litigation convenience for litigation participants through the electronic litigation service platform, the trial process information disclosure platform and other litigation service platforms, and shall support the filing of cases, payment of fees, review of case files, exchange of evidence, service of documents, court sessions, etc. through network means.
Article 19 These Provisions shall come into force on July 1, 2018.
